1jv4o6h:195: The initial vector of this incident was a GitHub access token obtained by an unauthorized party. GitHub token leakage is one of the most common upstream supply chain risks for SaaS/open-source projects. Unlike directly breaking into the production environment, an attacker only needs a token with repo read permission to silently download the entire codebase without leaving a trace. This "low-interaction, long-lurking" pattern is exactly the typical strategy of data extortion groups such as CoinbaseCartel.
